Reference image for the [[Jokes]] block on [[Moving To Attack Position]]: a Second World War poster, "All Harvester products are war products... either for offense or defense", from the United States Office for Emergency Management, War Production Board (about 1942–1943). It is the picture English Wikipedia uses for its article on the adage "The best defense is a good offense".
